verdict.rationale: Google's docs confirm passkey creation (device-bound, discoverable credential) for signing into a Google Account without a password (google-titan-docs-2, docs-15/16), which implies resident-key/FIDO2 support, but the same documentation set explicitly limits third-party site compatibility to 'FIDO CTAP1 standards' (google-titan-docs-4) rather than affirmatively citing FIDO2/CTAP2 or discoverable-credential certification broadly across services. No independent hands-on confirmation of passwordless/discoverable sign-in flow is present in the community evidence. Missing for 10: explicit FIDO2/CTAP2 resident-key certification language, third-party WebAuthn site testing confirming username-less sign-in, and hands-on community validation of passkey/resident-key behavior.
